instruction.name: xvsetanyeqz.w
instruction.description: Set FCC based on vector elements.

experiments.name: dependency chain through FCC
experiments.notes: The chain closes through movcf2gr (3 cycles) and xvreplgr2vr.d (1 cycle), so 4 cycles of closure are subtracted. Measured with the slope method (--unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000) on 2026-11-17.

latencies.notes: xvsetanyeqz.w reads the whole vector and produces FCC in 3 cycles; the move back to a vector register is what makes the chain measurable.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc0, $xr8; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc1, $xr9; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc2, $xr10; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc3, $xr11; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc4, $xr12; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc5, $xr13; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc6, $xr14; xvsetanyeqz.w $fcc7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 4.03 cycles. The measured CPI 0.5038 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: xvsetanyeqz.w latency to FCC is 3 cycles, measured by closing the loop through movcf2gr and xvreplgr2vr.d (round trip 7.00 cycles minus 4).
